result:
Each query below is written from the documentation page alone. I could not run any of them, so none is tested. Several steps rest on assumptions the page does not confirm:
- **`round`:** I assumed `round 2` rounds to two decimals.
- **Two-modifier arithmetic:** I assumed `sub /s /d` and `div /0 /1` use the first modifier as the left operand.
- **Empty `sum`:** I assumed `sum` of an empty vector is 0.
- **No `trim` verb:** N10 and N14 strip spaces with `split " " | join ""`, which only works because the tags and package lines contain no internal spaces.
- **Number parsing:** N7 uses `parseJson` to turn numeric strings into numbers.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) * (/email | split "@" | /1 | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * {:c /customer/name :s (/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) :d (at :discount | coalesce 0)} * {:c /c :a (sub /s /d)} | groupBy ~/c * (* /a | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy * count
N4: [(at :dependencies | coalesce {}) (at :devDependencies | coalesce {})] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | vals | :en / | {:enabledCount (en | count) :ports (en * (at :port) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (en * (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") * (split " " | /2 | drop 1 | split "]" | /0) | groupBy * count | entries * {:service (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "") * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~/r * (* /v | sum | round 2)
N8: :l (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") * /user | distinct) | :o (filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") * /user | distinct) | l | minus o | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~/dept * (* /salary | [sum count] | div /0 /1 | round 1)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ":" | /1 | split "," * (split " " | join "" | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] * lower | groupBy * count | entries | filter ~(/1 | gt 1) * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets * (/download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~([(/downloads | desc)]) | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | :t / | {:count (t | count) :allPriced (t | every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (t | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) * /name | sort)}
N14: lines * (split "#" | /0 | split " " | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * (split "==" | [(/0 | lower | keyword) /1]) | tag ::map
